name: K44 API Check
description: Vérifie l'API Kaen44 après modification des routes serveur

then.command: powershell -Command "try { $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:3001/health' -TimeoutSec 5; Write-Host \"K44 local: $($r.status)\" } catch { try { $r2 = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'https://funesterie.me/health' -TimeoutSec 5; Write-Host \"K44 prod: $($r2.status)\" } catch { Write-Host \"K44: DOWN\" } }"
